mapper.select:
SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID id, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID||':'||FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR text,
FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodId
FROM FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId}
WHERE 1=1
AND (FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LIKE concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
AND FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE = #{dealMode10}
AND FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL
mapper.sql:
select t.validStatus, t.periodProdId, t.periodId, to_char(t.investCycle) investCycle, t.publishType, t.rateType, t.rateLower, t.rateLimit, t.rate, t.indexId, t.coefficient, t.spreadRate, t.resetType, t.termType, t.baseRule, t.startDate, t.endDate, t.p_finprod_id as finprodId, t.branch, t.effDate from( select '有效' validStatus, fp.p_finprod_id periodProdId, ftp.period_id periodId, ftp.term investCycle, ftp.vdate startDate, ftp.mdate endDate, fbri.publish_type publishType, fbri.rate_type rateType, fbri.rate_lower *100 rateLower, fbri.rate_limit *100 rateLimit, fbri.rate * 100 rate, fbri.index_id indexId, fbri.coefficient, fbri.spread_rate *100 spreadRate, fbri.reset_type resetType, fpa.term_type termType, case when fbri.publish_type = #{publishType01} then to_char(fbri.rate_lower *100, 'fm9990.0099999') || '~' || to_char(fbri.rate_limit *100, 'fm9990.0099999') when fbri.rate_type = #{calcType01} then to_char(fbri.rate * 100, 'fm9990.0099999') when fbri.rate_type = #{calcType02} then ite.text ||'*'|| fbri.coefficient ||'+'||to_char(fbri.spread_rate*100,'fm9990.0099999') end as baseRule, fp.p_finprod_id, ftp.branch, fbri.EFF_DATE effDate from fin_trade_product ftp left join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_id = ftp.finprod_id left join fin_base_rule_info fbri on fbri.finprod_id = ftp.finprod_id and fbri.branch = ftp.branch left join (SELECT ITEM_CODE id, ITEM_VALUE text FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST WHERE DICT_CODE = 'SECRATE_DATA' UNION ALL SELECT INDEX_ID id, INDEX_NAME text FROM MST_INDEX_INFO) ite on ite.id = fbri.index_id left join fin_product_add fpa on fpa.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id
inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ppa on fpa.PORTFOLIO_ID = ppa.PORTFOLIO_ID and ppa.USER_ID = #{userId}
where fbri.eff_date = ( select max(t.eff_date) from fin_base_rule_info t where t.base_rule_id = fbri.base_rule_id and t.branch != 0 and t.eff_date <= to_date(#{platDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) and fbri.base_rule_type = #{baseRuleType01} and ftp.finprod_type2 = #{F26} ) t
and t.p_finprod_id in
#{item}
and t.startDate >= to_date(#{startDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and t.startDate <= to_date(#{startDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and t.endDate >= to_date(#{endDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and t.endDate <= to_date(#{endDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
mapper.select:
select distinct fpa.investment_cycle id, fpa.investment_cycle text from fin_product fp left join fin_product_add fpa on fpa.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where 1=1 and investment_cycle is not null
and fp.p_finprod_id = #{finprodId}

select fp.finprod_id periodProdId, fp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, fpa.investment_cycle investCycle, fp.ccy, fpa.term_type termType, fp.profit_type profitType from fin_product fp left join fin_product_add fpa on fpa.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.p_finprod_id = #{finprodId}
and fpa.investment_cycle = #{investCycle}

select fbri.rate_type rateType, fbri.rate * 100 rate, fbri.index_id indexId, fbri.index_source indexSource, fbri.coefficient, fbri.spread_rate *100 spreadRate, fbri.reset_type resetType, fbri.publish_type publishType, fbri.rate_lower *100 rateLower, fbri.rate_limit *100 rateLimit, fbri.remark from fin_base_rule_info fbri where fbri.finprod_id = #{periodProdId}
and fbri.branch = #{branch} and fbri.eff_date = ( select max(t1.eff_date) from fin_base_rule_info t1 where t1.base_rule_id = fbri.base_rule_id and t1.eff_date <= to_date(#{platDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) and fbri.base_rule_type = #{baseRuleType}

select distinct fci.fee_id feeId, ffcr.base_rule baseRule, ffcr.ast_vdate_type astVdateType, fccr.f_accr_date fAccrDAte, mf.basic_bill basicBill, mf.basis basis, fccr.accr_type accrType, fccr.interval_rule intervalRule, fccr.f_accr_end_date fAccrEndDate, fccr.accr_day_type accrDayType, fccr.e_accr_date eAccrDate, fci.first_pay_date firstPayDate, fci.end_tday_rule endTdayRule, fci.pay_tday_rule payTdayRule, fci.pay_cycle payCycle, fci.cash_id periodCashId, fci.remark from (select fci.cash_id, fci.finprod_id, fci.fee_id, fcpr.first_pay_date, fcpr.end_tday_rule, fcpr.pay_tday_rule, fcpr.pay_cycle, fcpr.remark from fin_cash_info fci left join fin_cash_pay_rule fcpr on fci.cash_id = fcpr.cash_id where fci.cash_type_1 = #{cashType1} and fci.cash_type_2 = #{cashType2} and fci.finprod_id = #{periodProdId}
and fci.branch = #{branch} and fci.finprod_type = #{type01}) fci, fin_float_calc_rule ffcr,fin_float_counting_rule fccr, mst_feeinfo mf, fin_product fp where fci.cash_id = ffcr.cash_id and fci.cash_id = fccr.cash_id and fci.fee_id = mf.fee_id and fci.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id

select fcpr.cash_id cashId, fcpr.eff_date effDate, fcpr.pay_cycle_val payCycleVal, fcpr.pay_cycle payCycle, fcpr.day_type dayType, fcpr.day_value dayValue, fcpr.end_tday_rule endTdayRule, fcpr.pay_tday_rule payTdayRule, fcpr.calc_rule calcRule, fcpr.first_pay_date firstPayDate, fcpr.cash_unit_type cashUnitType, fcpr.finprod_id finprodId, fcpr.finprod_type finprodType, fcpr.finprod_type2 finprodType2, fcpr.branch, fcpr.pay_type payType, fcpr.remark from fin_cash_pay_rule fcpr where fcpr.cash_id = #{periodCashId} and fcpr.eff_date = ( select max(eff_date) from fin_cash_pay_rule where eff_date <= to_date(#{platDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') )

select fcpr.cash_id cashId, fcpr.eff_date effDate, fcpr.calc_type calcType, fcpr.base_type baseType, fcpr.base_date_type baseDateType, fcpr.basis, fcpr.yield, fcpr.is_initial isInitial, fcpr.finprod_id finprodId, fcpr.finprod_type finprodType, fcpr.finprod_type2 finprodType2, fcpr.branch, fcpr.remark from fin_cash_calc_rule fcpr where fcpr.cash_id = #{periodCashId} and fcpr.eff_date = ( select max(eff_date) from fin_cash_calc_rule where eff_date <= to_date(#{platDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') )

select fcpr.cash_id cashId, fcpr.eff_date effDate, fcpr.base_rule baseRule, fcpr.ast_vdate_type astVdateType, fcpr.act_rule actRule, fcpr.remark, fcpr.base_type baseType, fcpr.base_date_type baseDateType, fcpr.basis from fin_float_calc_rule fcpr where fcpr.cash_id = #{periodCashId} and fcpr.eff_date = ( select max(eff_date) from fin_float_calc_rule where eff_date <= to_date(#{platDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') )
select count(0) from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t where t.finprod_id = #{periodProdId} and t.branch = #{branch} AND t.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (t.IS_CANCEL='N' or t.IS_CANCEL IS NULL)
select count(0) from fin_trade_product t where t.period_id = #{periodId}

SELECT count(1) FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL INNER JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.BRANCH where FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.PERIOD_ID = #{periodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL='N' or TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL IS NULL)

select count(0) from fin_trade_product t where t.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.vdate = to_date(#{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') and t.mdate = to_date(#{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
